users.title: Team & invitations
users.description: Your agency members, their roles, and sent invitations.
users.inviteDescription: They'll get an email with a link valid for 7 days to create their account.
users.inviteResent: Invitation re-sent with a new link.
users.revokeBody: {email} won't be able to use the link we sent.
users.noInvitationsBody: Invite your teammates to join the workspace.
users.overridesHint: Permissions come from roles. You can grant or deny a permission for this member only; deny always wins.
users.deactivateHint: Access is removed immediately; their history and files stay.
users.reactivateHint: Access is restored with their current roles.
users.deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in until reactivated.
users.reactivateBody: They'll be able to sign in again.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Decide what each role can do. The database always enforces these permissions.
roles.agencyRolesHint: What your team can do in the workspace.
roles.clientRolesHint: What client users can do in the portal.
roles.cannotGrant: You can't grant a permission you don't have
roles.pendingChanges: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
roles.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
roles.deleteBody: The role “⁨{name}⁩” will be permanently deleted.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Organize your team by discipline and set each department's lead.
departments.archivedHint: Archived departments are hidden from lists; their data stays.
departments.membersHint: Choose the department's members and mark the leads.
departments.deleteBody: Departments are deleted right away (they don't go to the Trash). {count, plural, =0 {It has no members.} one {Its # member can move to another department.} other {Its # members can move to another department.}} Open tasks and workflow steps move with them.

organization.title: Agency settings
organization.description: Your agency's identity as your team and clients see it.
organization.logoHint: Square PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
organization.identityHint: Name and logo across the platform and emails.
organization.brandingHint: Used in the client portal and emails.
organization.preview: Preview of buttons and accents in your brand color.
organization.contactHint: Shown to clients in the portal.

features.title: Modules & features
features.description: Turn platform modules on or off for your agency.
features.liveHint: Turning a module off hides it from navigation and the portal immediately.
features.upcomingHint: Built in upcoming phases. Enabling them now shows their pages with a “coming soon” state.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change to important data: who, what and when, with before and after values.
